items.title: The Registration Committee (RC) recalled its decision taken in its 469th meeting under Agenda item no, 3.1 wherein the RC sought geo-tagging details of the manufacturing location of the source of import in overseas country. The RC observed that geo-tagging details, duly legalized/apostilled by the competent authority of the respective country, may be considered as proof of the manufacturing location, along with a location map indicating the place where manufacturing activities are carried out. The Registration Committee (RC) recalled its earlier decisions taken in its 469th meeting under Agenda Item No. 3.1 and 470th meeting under Agenda Item No. 8.2, wherein the RC had sought geo-tagging details of the manufacturing location in the overseas country.
items.decision: The RC decided that the geo-tagging details, duly legalized/apostilled by the competent authority of the respective country, may be considered as valid proof of the manufacturing location. Such submission should be Minutes of 471st RC meeting held on 16.04.2026 accompanied by a location map indicating the precise place of manufacturing; indicating the site where the manufacturing activities are being carried out. The RC further decided that the Geo-tagging of all the registrant shall be obtained irrespective of import or indigenous. The geo tagging shall be made the part of requirement of all the guidelines for uniformly implementation and accurate locations. All the applicant should submit geo-tagging details once this feature is made live on CROP portal. CGG may be requested to develop this feature urgently.

items.title: Consolidated Pendency Report relating applications for registration in CIB&RC The members had a detailed discussion on the pending applications and requirement of manpower to dispose-of these applications. The RC emphasized the urgent need of extra workforce as the work has been increased manifold.

Email communication dated 10.04.2026 received from M/s Drosera International Pvt Ltd, regarding order dated 11.03.2026 passed in appeal no 12 of 2025. RC at first stage observed that the contentions raised by the applicant had already been considered by the RC in its 470th meeting at agenda item No. 3.1. However, since the applicant had now raised some additional points with respect to the following aspects: 1. Absence of Established Framework for GLP Shelf-Life Studies 2. Scientific Redundancy in Crop Trial Requirements 3. Practical Constraints Relating to RTT Requirement
items.decision: RC deliberated the matter and observed that after a series of detailed deliberations made in 467th, 468th & 470th meeting; the RC had already considered the suggestions made by the stake holders and therefore RC don’t find any cogent reason to modify or amend the guidelines captioned in the matter pertaining to the TI-New Source as the requirements laid down are fully scientifically justified and RC expects its compliance from all the stake holders so as to ensure availability of safer and quality pesticides to the farmers. As far as the applicability of the captioned guidelines is concerned, RC in its 470th meeting has already clarified that the additional data requirements shall be implemented for all applications. RC is further of the view that the persons who had obtained a RTT permit for the purposes of data generation can and should follow the additional data requirements since the application under TI New source is not submitted or pending before the RC. Therefore, with highest regards to the observations of the Hon’ble Appellate Authority in its order dated 11.03.2026, the representation of the applicant dated 10.04.2026 is accordingly disposed-of.

items.title: Mandatory requirement of State verification Letter from Directorate of Agriculture for unfreezing User accounts on Crop Portal. The Committee was apprised that, in reference to the Public Notice dated 16.02.2026, communications had been issued to firms as well as to the Directorates of Agriculture of all States and Union Territories for compliance with the decision taken by the Registration Committee in its 468th meeting under Agenda Item No. 10.58. The Committee further noted that, pursuant to the said communications, the following categories of requests have been received from firms: i. Requests for merging of multi user accounts into the main approved KYC account; ii. Requests for unfreezing and merging as the case may be for user accounts on the CROP Portal (Freezed non-KYC account). In such cases the applicant has never completed KYC process. The Committee observed that a number of applicants have submitted requests for unfreezing of their user accounts on the CROP Portal without enclosing a State Verification Letter issued by the Directorate of Agriculture of the concerned State.
items.decision: The Committee noted that, in the absence of such verification, it becomes difficult to ascertain the authenticity, operational status, and functional existence of the applicant firms. After detailed deliberations, the Committee decided as under: 1. Requests for merging of multi user accounts into the main approved KYC account may be processed as per existing mechanism. 2. Requests for unfreezing and merging as the case may be for user accounts on the CROP Portal (Freezed non-KYC account). In such cases the applicant has never completed KYC process: a. The submission of a valid State Verification Letter, duly issued by the Directorate of Agriculture of the concerned State, shall be made mandatory for processing requests for unfreezing of user accounts on the CROP Portal. b. The State Verification Letter shall clearly certify that the firm is operational and functional. c. Requests for unfreezing of user accounts not accompanied by the requisite State Verification Letter shall not be processed until the same is submitted. Minutes of 471st RC meeting held on 16.04.2026 d. The Secretariat may, wherever considered necessary, seek independent confirmation regarding the operational status of the firm from the concerned Directorate of Agriculture through official communication/email. The RC further directed the Sectt. of CIB&RC to issue a Public Notice to this effect requesting the State Govts. for verifying the authenticity of the information/claim submitted by the applicants/company/entity/firm to respective State authorities.
